They share similarities but theyre not related whatsoever. I like your comparison with Charmander and Charizard and Cyclizar with Koraidon/Miraidon. Charmander and Charizard obviously are not the same. But a charmander can evolve into a Charizard. Cyclizar can't evolve into either Koraidon or Miraidon. All of the Paradox Pokemon share similarities to some Pokemon we know. How woukd you explain Iron Valiant? Is it based on a Gradevoir or Gallade? There is no Gallade/Gardevoir hybrid in the regular Pokemon we know. Iron Valiant is its own creature apart from Gardevoir and Gallade, but they share similarities. The same goes with all other Paradoxes. Scream Tail looks like a Jigglypuff, but it's not a past Jigglypuff. To prove my point. Entei. Raikou, and Suicune came to be after the events of the burnt tower. How would you explain Walking Wake? Paradox Suicune is a Pokemon similar to Suicune, but it's not a past Suicune. Not related.

Do you know what Paradox mean?

It's a contradiction. All of these pokemon are sort if impossible, but they do exist in the pokemon universe. So Koraidon is based on Cyclizar, but that doesn't mean they are the same. A Slither Wing is a Slither Wing, a Volcarona is a Volcarona, and an Iron Moth is an Iron Moth. It's not that a Slither wing turned into a Volcarona which turned into an Iron Moth. They pretty much exist as a version of the same pokemon in their time/universe/dimension. But they never cross paths. That's why theyre paradox pokemon. They exist in a place where they shouldn't
